description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced SDC/Infection Control Nurse to join a premier skilled nursing facility in Oakland, MD. This vital role combines the critical functions of staff development and infection prevention, ensuring the highest standards of care and safety for both residents and staff. You will play a key role in educating our team and implementing robust infection control protocols.

In this dynamic position, you will be responsible for developing and delivering comprehensive training programs for nursing staff, fostering continuous professional growth and competency. Concurrently, you will lead our infection prevention efforts, conducting surveillance, implementing best practices, and ensuring compliance with all regulatory guidelines. This is an urgent opening, offering a competitive hourly rate for a professional ready to make an immediate impact.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Maryland
Proven experience in staff development or nursing education
Demonstrated experience in infection prevention and control
Strong knowledge of state and federal regulations related to infection control and staff education
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation is $40-$42 per hour, based on experience.
